integrity: Exact algebraic proof included. Standalone numerical rank comparisons (2531 passed) are corroborative, not proofs over the infinite parameter domain. Historical-priority status is limited by inspected sources and incomplete access to some related records. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted triangular graphs \(J(n,2)\), \(n\ge5\), with nonempty sets of strictly positive absorbers and adjacency-generated coherent dynamics. The theorem concerns bright/dark dimensions and absorption from the maximally mixed state, not localized-source times, nonuniform coherent couplings, decoherence, or arbitrary Johnson graphs.
title: Bipartite-component formula for the absorbing spectral rank of triangular quantum graphs
